== Dorothy and the Wizard in Oz ==

=== Infobox ===

* Name: Pyramid Mountain
* Place type: Mountain

Pyramid Mountain lies beyond a stretch of the valley, reached by following the river that flows in its direction. To get there, travelers must cross a mile or so of the valley, a stretch with few houses, orchards, or flowers, where the risk of encountering savage bears is feared. A man with braids maintains a factory halfway up the mountain, in a spot he describes as no longer inhabited by him at the surface, having lived there for many years.
</div>

== Events ==

After resisting the invisibility-granting dama-fruit and learning they must cross toward Pyramid Mountain to continue their journey, the travelers make their way there by river. Once at the mountain, they climb a long spiral stairway inside it leading toward the Land of the Gargoyles.
